justifications.r1: Massive landfall landramp (Scapeshift, Splendid Reclamation, Awaken the Woods).
justifications.r2: Skullclamp, Idol of Oblivion, Species Specialist, and dredge draw cards on zombie ETB/death.
justifications.a1: Crop Rotation, Scapeshift, and land tutors find Field of the Dead and Dark Depths.
justifications.a2: Assembles Field of the Dead zombie spigot on Turns 4–5.
justifications.p1: Presents massive 20+ zombie swarm on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 1–2 opponent untap steps for combat, or Noxious Ghoul one-sided wipe.
justifications.p3: Land drops and zombies are clearly visible on table.
justifications.i1: Swords to Plowshares, Beast Within, and Noxious Ghoul asymmetrical wipes.
justifications.i2: Noxious Ghoul gives all opposing non-Zombies -1/-1 per zombie landfall, wiping opposing boards.
justifications.s1: Teferi's Protection, Heroic Intervention, and Clever Concealment.
justifications.s2: Splendid Reclamation and Lumra replay all lands from graveyard post-wipe.
justifications.s3: Field of the Dead in the 99 functions independently of commander.
